notes.title: Total Rework: Fatigue and Directional Attacks
notes.content: [h1]Combat System Rework – Cat‑Astrophy Demo[/h1][p] [b]The skills system has been completely reworked![/b] You can now assign different attacks to each direction and discover new customizable synergies with a much more strategic focus.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Reworks and Major Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New fatigue system (0–100)[/b]: Each attack generates fatigue based on its type, and it doesn't regenerate automatically. You must pause or end combat to recover. This introduces a tactical pacing to fights.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tiered fatigue[/b]: Chaining more hits costs increasingly more. Starting from the third hit, costs rise notably—encouraging more technical and deliberate fighting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable directional attacks[/b]: A new menu lets you assign different skills to each direction (up, down, forward), unlocking unique combos and strategic synergies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual fatigue indicators[/b]: The UI has been redesigned to include a constantly visible bar and special effects when modules like ‘Ecstasy’ are active.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New tactical progression[/b]: The system now rewards precision, rhythm control, and planned strikes instead of just button‑mashing.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068070/d3edcb66d2a0966ab029fc8c3e0fc7097da70e92.png"][/img][/p][p]With this redesign, combat in [b]Cat‑Astrophy[/b] becomes a deeper, more strategic, and satisfying experience. Every hit counts, every pause matters, and your playstyle evolves to new heights.[/p]

notes.title: Cat-Astrophy DEMO: Massive Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - Cat-Astrophy Demo[/h1][h2][b]New Challenges and Content[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Two new mini-bosses[/b]: Two mini-bosses with unique and challenging mechanics have been added. Each introduces new combat patterns that will test the players' skill.[/*][*][b]20 new levels[/b]: Exploration expands with the addition of 20 new levels, bringing new challenges and surprises.[/*][*][b]New soundtrack[/b]: New music tracks have been added to enhance the immersion and dynamics of each session.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068070/277e3d233e2db8c84f42a3819099f9329b4753ee.png[/img][h2][b]Improvements and Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Sound effects optimization[/b]: All sound effects have been adjusted and refined to improve immersion and provide a more enveloping auditory experience.[/*][*][b]Pixel art update[/b]: Graphics have been refined to improve visual consistency and detail level.[/*][*][b]Illustrations redesign[/b]: All in-game illustrations have been updated to improve artistic cohesion and enrich the game’s atmosphere.[/*][*][b]New visual interface[/b]: The interface has been completely revamped with a cleaner, more modern design, optimizing navigation and user experience.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068070/1c95d2ffd3af111971b4d76be82265526547f9fa.png[/img][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Voice acting in multiple languages[/b]: Now available in Catalan, English, and Spanish, improving accessibility for players from different regions.[/*][*][b]New language - Portuguese[/b]: The demo is now available in Portuguese, expanding its reach to more players.[/*][*][b]New synergy mechanic[/b]: Inventory items can now interact with each other, allowing strategic combinations that provide additional bonuses and expand customization options.[/*][*][b]New reward system[/b]: An improved reward system has been implemented to reward players for their achievements, encouraging exploration and progress.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068070/c409400b656d5a3d9fdb6aae47955c82ea3bb5c5.png[/img][h2][b]Reworks and Significant Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Octarianthar rework[/b]: This boss has been completely redesigned with new attacks and combat patterns. Its new mechanics will present a challenge even for the most experienced players.[/*][*][b]Redesign of the “Lick” ability[/b]: The ability has been reworked. New description: [b]Temporarily increases attack speed by 20% and movement speed by 10% for 5 seconds.[/b][/*][*][b]Deep restructuring of the story[/b]: The narrative of Cat-Astrophy has been fully revised to improve coherence and flow, providing a more immersive experience.[/*][*][b]Dialogue improvements[/b]: All in-game dialogues have been reviewed and optimized to enhance immersion and emotional connection with the characters.[/*][/list][h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Bug fixes[/b]: Various bugs have been fixed to improve game stability and fluidity.[/*][*][b]Revolution in the item system[/b]: The item and currency system has been removed and replaced by the [b]Reconfiguration System[/b], which significantly increases replayability and allows players to customize their gameplay style in each session.[/*][*][b]Mini-games removal[/b]: Mini-games have been removed to focus on improving the core gameplay experience.[/*][/list]
With this patch, the Cat-Astrophy demo reaches a new level of quality. We hope you enjoy all the changes and improvements. We are open to receiving feedback, reviews, or any comments you may have. Your opinion is important to us!
